maya (docs): quick sync — I want to merge two docs PRs tomorrow AM: migration-guide update (adds v1.12 notes + rollback section) and SDK snippet refresh for JS/py. Need reviewer assignment + preview greenlight.
simon (eng): pinging @maya — which release branch do you want these on? main or release/v1.12-docs?
maya (docs): prefer release/v1.12-docs so versioned site picks up changes. will cherry-pick to main later.
jess (pm): FYI feature flag for the new auth flow cuts off Thurs 03/26 23:59 PT. If docs reference the new flag we should gate or note it.
maya (docs): good call — I removed the explicit flag examples, added a note: "only visible when FF enabled". will call that out in PR description.
ci-bot: Netlify preview posted: https://deploy-preview-123--redwood-docs.netlify.app — build: FAILED (link-check)
maya (docs): ugh link-check failure — anyone have bandwidth to eyeball? snippet references an internal example link that needs to be replaced with the public gist.
oliver (qa): I can take a pass in 20m. quick question: do we need a canary docs rollout or just merge after preview passes? :eyes:
simon (eng): recommend canary. If we merge directly into release branch during cutoff window it might surface runtime expectations. Canary = merge to release/v1.12-docs-canary, point staging to that for a day.
jess (pm): agree with canary. Also coordinate with the deploy window: infra scheduled release window is Fri 06:00-08:00 UTC. Docs merge should be before canary so staging has time to validate.
maya (docs): proposed plan: 1) replace internal link with public gist (I will) 2) trigger preview, oliver reviews, 3) if green, merge to release/v1.12-docs-canary at 04:00 UTC Fri, validate on staging for 6-12h, then promote to release/v1.12-docs before 06:00 UTC Fri.
simon (eng): timeline makes sense. add me as reviewer on both PRs. I can quick-approve infra-related wording.
ci-bot: Link check warning: URL https://internal.example.com/snippets/auth -> 404 in /guides/migration.md line 84
maya (docs): fixed link to gist and pushed. Triggering preview with yarn docs:preview --branch release/v1.12-docs-canary

```bash
# local preview
yarn install
yarn docs:preview
```

oliver (qa): reviewing now. focusing on the migration steps and the SDK codeblocks. will flag any regressions.
oliver (qa): small nit — the python snippet uses old client init, suggest new init: `Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), region="us-west")`
maya (docs): thanks — updated snippet. also added a short note about rolling back to prior model config if latency regressions show up.
jess (pm): do we need a docs-change log entry for the release notes?
maya (docs): yes — added a one-liner under v1.12 changelog: "migration notes + SDK snippet updates".
simon (eng): tagging docs PR with reviewers: @simon, @oliver. also please add `priority: high` label so release squad is aware.
maya (docs): done. CI preview now: PASSED :white_check_mark: https://deploy-preview-123--redwood-docs.netlify.app
jess (pm): sweet. I'll schedule a quick regression check during staging window.
maya (docs): final check — any blockers to merging to canary at 04:00 UTC Fri?
simon (eng): none from infra side.
oliver (qa): none from QA after my pass.
jess (pm): none from PM. go ahead. :shipit:
maya (docs): merging to release/v1.12-docs-canary at 04:00 UTC Fri and will update this thread when promoted to release/v1.12-docs. thanks all.
ci-bot: Deploy hook: merged PR #456 to release/v1.12-docs-canary — preview build queued.
